name: SCW Commissioner Championship
epitaph: The fed's own served Belts and Champions page names Viper — the roster page's own billed Co-CEO — as Commissioner Champion, the only one of the fed's six titles not recorded vacant on the same page. One reign anchors the ledger here: the only one attested.

name: SCW World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Never held, on the record that survives — billed vacant on the fed's own Belts and Champions page, one of five of the fed's six titles recorded that way on the same document.
notes: Billed "(VACANT)" on the fed's own Belts and Champions page. No reign is recorded anywhere in the held record.
